decisions.title: Bedroom casement sheers: inside-reveal, curtain_sheer by name, alpha from spec.curtains.render_state, sill-length, drawn-only
probes: spec.casement_sheers block exists and covers exactly glz-west-win1 + glz-west-win2
a pure module (casement_sheers.py) owns the layout; curtains.py is byte-untouched
build_room has a consumer (_add_casement_sheers) invoked from build_suite; runs after _add_curtains; RAISES if material 'curtain_sheer' is absent
every sheer ribbon object carries ph_model=True
sheer z derives from opening sill_mm/head_mm, not floor-to-ceiling
state 'parked' RAISES (drawn-only until a park is designed)
material_story(canonical spec) contains a casement-sheers bit naming alpha-0.38 sheers, unoccluded opal strips, and the bare mirror pier
no blackout data exists at glz-west-win1/2 (recorded absence)

decisions.title: Ensuite casements BARE

ensuite_material_story_bits output contains a BARE-casements / no-curtain-blind-fabric line, gated on the ensuite subroom + its openings existing

decisions.title: Towels on the locked Purist set: bar (WC-to-curb west segment), south jamb hook = hand towel, north jamb hook = robes x2, paper holder re-sited north of the cistern; greige-oatmeal terry census
probes: bathroom.py emits towel_bar + robe_hook x2 + paper_holder parts, every hardware part mat='brass'
paper holder position is NORTH of the WC cistern band (not inside the built wc_tank massing)

towel census lives in spec data (bath x2 bar, hand x1 south hook + x1 counter, robe x2 north hook, mat x1) and the emitters build a soft mass for every census entry (hardware succeeding with zero textiles must fail a test)
textile parts use the single shared mat token 'towel'
the Purist schedule FILE is byte-untouched (18in fallback, if taken, is spec data)
material_story names the towels, their ONLY locations, and 'no towel over the glass or tub edge'

decisions.title: Bath mat at the shower entry gap in the drawn dry strip; centre DERIVED from built shower geometry; no tub-wash pooling claim
probes: a bath-mat part exists with mat token 'towel'
the mat centre derives from shower_parts' built entry gap (screen end to shower east edge), not a hardcoded x
no artifact claims the mat sits under the tub wash (the claim was refuted: element5_lighting aims both cones into the tub)
the mat is the suite's only ensuite floor textile (mat-not-rug; bedroom rug untouched)

decisions.title: Wet/dry textile law: no textile enters the wet zone
probes: no textile-mat part lies inside the shower enclosure or on the tub deck/glass
the ensuite story bit carries the no-towel-over-glass-or-tub-edge wording

router_closure_dependency: The 'towel' token requires ALL THREE branches: FIXTURE_MAT_OBJECT row + a mill_object_role branch (that router still ends in return 'oak' — the closed fixture_part_name gate is one layer up and does NOT protect this) + the build_room role-dict entry with the terry material built in _suite_materials. A row alone renders every towel in walnut with no raise.
